amendment.path: standard law-amendment procedure; loader refuses invalid amendment records

one_sentence: If work can be done at the same time, it is done at the same time; sequential execution of independent work is a defect.

conditions: no dependency in either direction (proven, not assumed)
concurrent execution preserves correctness of both

plan_valid.description: An execution plan satisfies the law.
plan_valid.form: plan_valid(P) := every task T in P with met_dependencies(T) is dispatched without waiting on any non-dependency

violation.description: Sequential execution of parallelizable tasks without a capacity reason.
violation.form: violation(P) := exists A,B in P: parallelizable(A,B) && sequential(A,B) && !capacity_bound

scorecard_check.name: parallelism_check
scorecard_check.rule: Every execution scorecard must answer: was any parallelizable work run sequentially? If yes, name it as a defect.

title: The Parallel Execution Law
